assumptions.assumption: The member is an external human entity.
assumptions.basis: The node is named "Member".

assumptions.assumption: The member carries personally identifying data.
assumptions.basis: A member is a person.

assumptions.assumption: Desk staff is an external human entity.
assumptions.basis: The node is named "Desk staff".

assumptions.assumption: Desk staff carries personally identifying data.
assumptions.basis: Desk staff refers to people.

assumptions.assumption: The self-service kiosk is a process.
assumptions.basis: The node is described as self-service and participates in library transaction flows.

assumptions.assumption: The self-service kiosk handles credentials.
assumptions.basis: The kiosk receives a library card.

assumptions.assumption: The lending API presents a web interface.
assumptions.basis: The node is explicitly named "Lending API (REST)"; REST is a web application interface.

assumptions.assumption: The lending API handles personally identifying data.
assumptions.basis: The API exchanges members data with the database.

assumptions.assumption: The lending API handles business-critical operating records.
assumptions.basis: The API exchanges loans and reservations and handles circulation operations.

assumptions.assumption: The loans database contains personally identifying data.
assumptions.basis: Its stated contents include members.

assumptions.assumption: The loans database contains business-critical operating records.
assumptions.basis: Its stated contents include loans and reservations.

assumptions.assumption: The loans database contents are confidential.
assumptions.basis: The stated contents include member records, loans, and reservations.

assumptions.assumption: The borrow, renew, and reserve flow carries business-critical operating records.
assumptions.basis: The flow names library transaction operations.

assumptions.assumption: The library card and book scans flow carries credentials.
assumptions.basis: The flow explicitly carries a library card.

assumptions.assumption: The loans and returns flow carries business-critical operating records.
assumptions.basis: The flow explicitly carries loans and returns.

assumptions.assumption: The circulation actions flow carries business-critical operating records.
assumptions.basis: The flow names loan, block, and return operations.

assumptions.assumption: The API-to-database flow carries personally identifying data.
assumptions.basis: The flow explicitly carries members.

assumptions.assumption: The API-to-database flow carries business-critical operating records.
assumptions.basis: The flow explicitly carries loans and reservations.

assumptions.assumption: The database-to-API flow carries personally identifying data.
assumptions.basis: The flow explicitly carries members.

assumptions.assumption: The database-to-API flow carries business-critical operating records.
assumptions.basis: The flow explicitly carries loans and reservations.

assumptions.assumption: The Branch network is a network trust boundary.
assumptions.basis: The zone is explicitly named "Branch network".

assumptions.assumption: The Council data centre is a network trust boundary.
assumptions.basis: The zone is explicitly named "Council data centre".
